verdict.rationale: Granola is an AI meeting-notes product with an agentic Chat, so it could plausibly act as an MCP client and the axis applies. The evidence only documents Granola as an MCP server that external AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT connect to, plus built-in Chat actions for Gmail, Slack and Calendar. Neither lets users plug arbitrary MCP servers into Granola, so neither counts toward this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
